fabricationFlags: Two fake 'master' degree programs injected: 'Master Class - Junior School - 15th June 2019' and 'Master Class - Senior School - 15th June 2019' are school NEWS/event posts (dated 2019) miscategorized as level='master' degree programmes with verified=true. Repton Dubai is a K-12 school and offers NO master's degrees.

Scholarship percentages fabricated/inflated: catalog claims Academic up to 50%, Sport up to 30%, Music/Performing Arts up to 25%, All-Rounder up to 20%. Official/reported scholarships are typically ~10% of tuition (Academic, Music, Sport only).
Invented scholarship categories: 'Performing Arts Scholarship' and 'All-Rounder Scholarship' are not offered by Repton Dubai (real categories are Academic, Music, Sport).
Scholarship eligibility wrong: official scholarships target Years 5-8 and IB Year 12; catalog frames Academic as Sixth Form / Year 12 IGCSE-result based with broad year coverage.
Tuition labelled USD though school publishes fees in AED only; values are correct AED->USD conversions (~0.2723) but currency presented as native USD which is not how the school quotes fees.
evidence: Official site reptondubai.org confirmed (KHDA Outstanding since 2014, first UK independent school in Middle East, Cognita group, Nad Al Sheba campus, boarding). PROGRAMS: Real curriculum (FS1-Year13, IGCSE KS4, A-Level + IB Sixth Form) matches catalog's first 6 entries; however 2 fabricated 'master' degree entries (2019 news posts) inflate the list - hence 'stale'. PRICES: Official fees page 2025-26 verified: Year7 AED81,121=$22,089(catalog 22089 EXACT), Year8 AED84,366=$22,972(22972 EXACT), Year9 AED86,529=$23,562(23561), Years10-11/IGCSE AED95,182=$25,917(25918), Years12-13 A-Level/IB AED102,753=$27,978(27978 EXACT). All 6 tuition values accurate. CAMPUSES: Nad Al Sheba campus, Performing Arts Centre, Sports Village, Early Years - all confirmed on official site; 60-acre figure plausible/consistent with descriptions. ACCOMMODATION: Boarding page confirms separate boys/girls boarding houses, dorms for younger + en-suite individual rooms for older, full boarding (AED72,000) and weekly boarding (AED66,500) for Years 7-13, day-student house system - all match catalog. SCHOLARSHIPS: official scholarships page returned no detail; corroborating search (whichschooladvisor/edarabia) indicates Repton Dubai scholarships ~10% of tuition for Academic/Music/Sport, eligible Years 5-8 and IB Year12 - catalog's 20-50% figures and 5 categories incl. Performing Arts/All-Rounder are fabricated/inflated.
